name: hygrow-root
description: Root package.json to run frontend and backend concurrently

scripts.start-frontend: npx ngrok config add-authtoken 3HrVqCG8J18J9YTqvDerZrvbBM0_7fmAAVvQMfttS6bevrENM && cd FrontEnd && npx expo start --tunnel --web
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd FrontEnd && npm install && cd ../BackEnd && npm install
scripts.build:eas-android: cd FrontEnd && npx eas-cli build -p android --profile production
scripts.build:eas-ios: cd FrontEnd && npx eas-cli build -p ios --profile production
scripts.update:live: cd FrontEnd && npx eas-cli update --branch production --message "Live Production Update"
